newsitem.title: USA: Roberts to pay $1.8 mln to settle suit.
newsitem.headline: Roberts to pay $1.8 mln to settle suit.

text.p: Roberts Pharmaceutical Corp said on Thursday that it had reached an agreement in principle to settle a shareholder class action filed against the company in April 1995 for a single, $6 million payment.
In a statement, the pharmaceutical company added that its insurance carrier would fund a major part of the payment, and that its net expense would amount to about $1.8 million before taxes.
The company's share of the settlement will be recorded as a non-operating, one-time charge in the third quarter of 1997, Roberts Pharmaceutical said.

"However, even after including this non-recurring charge, the third quarter of 1997 currently appears to be on track towards becoming the company's fourth consecutive quarter of profitability," the company said.
